reason: A web UI plugin that adds a searchable skill picker to the message composer, inserts official slash gestures into drafts, and relies on DSH's native skill-loading mechanism.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 的消息输入框提供可搜索、可排序的已安装技能选择器，并将所选技能以官方斜杠手势插入草稿。
summaries.en: Adds a searchable and sortable picker for installed skills to the DSH Web GUI composer and inserts the selected skill as the official slash gesture.

capabilities: Adds a skill-picker control to the web composer UI
Lists installed skill names and descriptions through the host skills API or local skill-directory scanning
Searches and sorts skill metadata, with recent and frequent usage stored in localStorage
Inserts an official /skill-name gesture into the message draft
Triggers the host's native skill-loading path when the user sends the message
